description_expanded: Big Gus - Luxury Vacation Rental on 30A with Private Pool and Beach Views Favorite Features: - Steps from Public Beach Access Across the Street - Ocean Views - Private Pool (Heat Available) - Golf Cart - Elevator - Multiple Living Areas - Dedicated Workspace Welcome to Big Gus, your ultimate beach retreat on the stunning 30A highway! This luxurious beach house is a dream come true, designed for maximum comfort and relaxation. With seven beautifully appointed bedrooms, it’s the perfect spot for large groups of up to 20 guests. The beach is conveniently located just across the street, making it easy to enjoy the sun and surf. An elevator ensures easy access to all floors, and a golf cart is available for exploring the beautiful surroundings of Seacrest Beach and Alys Beach, as well as enjoying the lively atmosphere at The Big Chill, a popular entertainment district for visitors and locals alike. Whether you’re planning a family reunion, a fun getaway with friends, or a corporate retreat, Big Gus has everything you need for an unforgettable stay. Out back, you can immerse yourself in the ultimate luxury experience! Take a refreshing dip in the private pool, which can be heated for year-round enjoyment. With plenty of seating and a nearby game room featuring a custom ping pong table, wet bar, living room, and dining table, the pool area is designed for pure relaxation and entertainment. It's the perfect place for poolside gatherings, game nights, and memorable meals with your loved ones. Fire up the outdoor grill, savor delicious meals, and soak in the invigorating coastal breeze. Get ready for unforgettable moments of fun and relaxation! Indoors, the spacious living room boasts breathtaking beach views and opens onto a balcony with cozy seating and a dining area. It's your go-to spot for enjoying your morning coffee, catching a stunning sunset, or simply unwinding while taking in the breathtaking scenery. The high-end kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring luxury appliances, a 6-burner gas stove, beautiful waterfall countertops, and bar seating for casual dining. Whether you're cooking a gourmet meal or whipping up a snack, this kitchen has you covered.  Each of the bedrooms is designed with comfort and style in mind, offering ample space and premium furnishings. A dedicated workspace is perfect for remote work or online assignments, ensuring you can stay productive while enjoying your time at the beach. With its seamless blend of work and play, this home is ideal for guests seeking the perfect balance of both. Thanks to its prime location, luxurious amenities, and thoughtful design, Big Gus offers an unparalleled lifestyle of sophistication and leisure. Every detail has been meticulously considered to provide you with a comfortable and enjoyable stay, from the spacious bedrooms and living areas to the high-end finishes and modern conveniences. Don't miss out – book your stay today and experience the epitome of coastal living on 30A! Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: 3 Twin over Twin Bunk Beds & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 2: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 3: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 4: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo.  Shared Balcony & Water View. Bedroom 5: King Bed with Water View & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo.  Bedroom 6: 2 Twin over Twin Bunk Beds & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 7: King Bed with Water View & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo.

Room Features: Primary King Suite w/ Private Bathroom

all: Primary King Suite w/ Private Bathroom
